Mixed purées

More mixed plates

További vegyes tányérok

6 months+ Sound idea 30 min 1 portion

Build one plate this way. Don’t skip the iron-rich food, and add the oil at the end.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 30 g iron food (cooked chicken, beef, lentils, or white beans; boil pulses until completely soft)
  • 40 g vegetable (cooked broccoli, carrot, peas, or pumpkin)
  • 40 g familiar fruit or starch (cooked sweet potato, potato, apple, or pear)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (stirred in at the end)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Put one iron food, one vegetable, and one familiar fruit or starch in the bowl.
  2. Use foods already cooked soft, with meat fully done and any beans or lentils boiled until they have no firm core.
  3. Add a teaspoon of rapeseed or olive oil and blend until smooth.
  4. One plate is chicken, broccoli, and sweet potato.
  5. Another is lentils, carrot, and potato, and a third is beef, peas, and cooked apple.
  6. Finish with white beans, pumpkin, and pear, and do not add salt or a stock cube.

Sound idea

A plate of fruit or starch alone misses iron. Oil is often forgotten, and salty stock is often used instead.

Build each plate from one iron food, one vegetable, one familiar fruit or starch, and a teaspoon of oil. Use the four example plates in the method, and do not add salt or stock.
